title: fitout configuration, format 1
description: fitout.toml in /etc/fitout: the modules of a container and their values.

catalog.description: URL (or absolute path) of the folder with the module files, by default the catalog folder of the fitout repository on main. Put a tag or commit instead of main to stay on one state.

modules.description: Enabled modules by name. A file modules/<name>.toml in the config folder replaces the catalog module of that name. Modules they require come along.

env.description: Values of module variables, not for secrets. The container environment wins.
